data.name: Shahbuddin

in_sanskrit.name: श्रीबुद्धन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: श्री (Shri) means God, prosperity, wealth, fortune. बुद्ध (Buddh) means intellect, knowledge, wisdom, enlightenment, and अन (an) means protector. Thus, the name श्रीबुद्धन (Shri Buddhan) means 'God's protector of intellect, knowledge, wisdom, enlightenment'.

in_hindi.name: शहबुद्दीन
in_hindi.long_meaning: शह (Shah) means ruler, king. बुद्धि (Buddhi) means intellect, knowledge, wisdom. दान (Daan) means giver, donor. Thus, the name शहबुद्दीन (Shahbuddeen) means 'ruler of the intellect, giver of knowledge'.

in_tamil.name: ஶாஹபுத்தின்
in_tamil.meaning: ஶாஹ் (Shah) புத்தி (Buddhi) இன் (in) - ஶாஹ் (Shah) means ruler, king. புத்தி (Buddhi) means intellect, knowledge, wisdom. இன் (in) means possessor, owner. Thus, the name ஶாஹபுத்தின் (Shahpuththin) means 'ruler of intellect, possessor of knowledge'.

in_telugu.name: శాహపుద్దిన్
in_telugu.meaning: శాహ్ (Shah) పుద్ది (Buddhi) ఇన్ (in) - శాహ్ (Shah) means ruler, king. పుద్ది (Buddhi) means intellect, knowledge, wisdom. ఇన్ (in) means possessor, owner. Thus, the name శాహపుద్దిన్ (Shahpuddinn) means 'ruler of intellect, possessor of knowledge'.

in_marathi.name: Shahbuddin
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King of the World
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shahbuddin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who rules over the world, a powerful king or leader.

in_bengali.name: Shahbuddin
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ King of the World
in_bengali.long_meaning: Shahbuddin একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who rules over the world, a powerful king or leader.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Shahbuddin" holds a rich historical and cultural significance in the Hindu society, as it signifies power, leadership and the rule of just and virtuous kings. The name has been borne by several notable figures in Hindu history, including Shahbuddin Mohammad Shahi of Bengal and Shahbuddin Gauri-i-Potia of Bidar. These leaders were known for their powerful reign, military prowess, and just rule, making the name a symbol of strength and leadership within the Hindu community.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Shahbuddin" lies in its indicative of the ultimate goal for every human being- to rule over one's own mind, body and desires, and thus, to attain inner peace and enlightenment. Just as a powerful king rules over his kingdom with wisdom and fairness, every individual must strive to rule their inner world with the same qualities. The name is therefore a reminder to continuously work towards self-mastery, self-discipline and self-realization, leading to a fulfilling spiritual journey.

historical_references.reference: Shahbuddin was the third ruler of the Iberian Bahmani Sultanate, reigning from 1458 to 1462. He is also known as Ahmad Shah I. During his rule, the capital city of the Bahmani Kingdom was shifted from Gulbarga to Bidar.

Shahbuddin, also known as Malik Ambar, was a powerful Deccan warlord in the late 16th and early 17th centuries. He served as the prime minister of the Nizam Shahi Kingdom from 1599 to 1606. During this period, he expanded the kingdom's territories significantly and established a strong military.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Shahbuddin is commonly associated with various Islamic figures during the medieval period in India. On Wikipedia, articles about Shahbuddin Khan Ghori, Shahbuddin Shahi, and Shahbuddin Ghazi are popular. On Reddit, users frequently discuss topics related to Shahbuddin Khanzada Ghori in various history, islamic history, and world history subreddits. On Quora, questions about Shahbuddin Muhammad Ghazi and his conquests are frequently asked.

name_in_real_life.story: Anita Shahbuddin from Chennai, India embodies the meaning of Shahbuddin - "King of the World". Growing up in a Hindu family, they were taught to honor the spiritual significance of their name and live according to dharma.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Shahbuddin: 'King of the God-given (Buddha) light'. A name embracing divine wisdom and regal power, symbolizing an enlightened ruler who governs with compassion and inner illumination.
